line: Bugs Bunny nigga got karats and shit (Karats and shit)
vault_lines: Bugs Bunny nigga got karats and shit (Karats and shit)
meaning: 21 Savage calls himself Bugs Bunny, a fictional bunny who enjoys eating carrots, a homonym of karats which is used in the line and refers to the rating of 21’s jewelry.

vault_lines: I don't see nothing wrong (Nothing wrong)
meaning: VVS stands for Very Very Slight, referring to the imperfections of a diamond. The fewer the imperfections, the higher the value.
